Description: Serves work items from Azure DevOps or on-prem TFS over the Work Item Tracking REST API — cloud and on-prem speak the same API, and the same connector that authenticates repositories also binds work items.

Settings.Label: Organization / collection URL
Settings.HelpText: Azure DevOps organization or on-prem TFS collection URL, e.g. https://dev.azure.com/acme or https://tfs.example.com/tfs/DefaultCollection.

Settings.Label: Personal access token
Settings.HelpText: PAT with work-item read/write scope; stored encrypted at rest and never displayed back.
